thread:
anjali: Heads-up — Trial customer (GearShift) wants a short SDK mini-PoC this week. Main asks: 1) quick pricing estimate for 10k tokens/day + 2) authz pattern for service accounts + 3) runbook for handing off to infra.
sarah: Nice. Do we have a standard checklist for trial handoffs? Can we reuse the onboarding runbook? :eyes:
devon: I can draft a lightweight checklist. For pricing: if they're on hosted, rough calc = base + per-token. For 10k tokens/day that's ~300k tokens/month. Send me exact prompt mix and we can model.
marco: Authz — GearShift is using Kratos + internal RBAC. They want short-lived creds for the SDK. Recommend ephemeral API keys via our token exchange (STS) or use OAuth client creds with scoped tokens.
anjali: They specifically asked about SSO and KMS access for embeddings (PII). Also legal will want encryption-at-rest details.
sarah: For trial we usually avoid giving KMS/HSM access. We can explain KMS options for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted, we offer managed encryption; for Private we can surface KMS integration details.
devon: Draft checklist items: 1) Confirm deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private) 2) Sample token flow (ephemeral?) 3) SDK quickstart + streaming example 4) Expected token volumes 5) Security questionnaire handoff
marco: Add one more: model pinning & fallback policy during the trial (so they don't trip noisy experiments).
anjali: Can someone paste a minimal SDK snippet for streaming + function calls we can drop in the email? Keep it language-agnostic if possible.
devon: Paste below — small Nodejs snippet we use for quick demos:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-mini-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize 1 paragraph' }] });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```
sarah: Looks good. Add a note about setting RW_API_KEY to an ephemeral token in the CI or rotating it every 12 hours.
marco: For authz pattern we usually recommend: 1) short-lived worker token via token-exchange 2) per-route scopes (read:embed, write:generate) 3) audit log forwarding to their SIEM.
anjali: Billing question — can we give them a trial cap? They want cost predictability while testing.
devon: Yes, set a usage quota on the account (max tokens/day) and add alerts. For pricing estimate: if hosted at $0.0006 per token (example), 300k tokens/month => $180. Add ~10% buffer for retries.
sarah: Don't quote numbers in public docs. Mark that as an estimate and flag Finance for official quote if they go beyond trial.
anjali: I'll send the initial email. Can someone prepare the security questionnaire stub? They sent a 5-page SOC-style questionnaire.
marco: I'll grab the answers for network, encryption, and access controls. Devon, can you prepare the SDK/telemetry section?
devon: On it. I'll include snippet on how to enable request-level telemetry and link to console dashboards. Also mention token scrubbing and retention policy.
anjali: Ops-bot — create a follow-up reminder for infra handoff tomo.
ops-bot: Reminder created: #infra-handoff to-do for GearShift trial on 2024-10-04 09:00 UTC. :bell:
sarah: One more ops note: recommend enabling prefix KV caching for embedding-heavy flows to save costs during the trial.
marco: Agreed. I'll note the cache TTL suggestion and batching knobs in the runbook.
anjali: Great — final deliverables for the email: checklist, Node snippet, short pricing estimate (devon), authz pattern (marco), security stub (marco+devon). I'll assemble and send before EOD. :thumbsup:
